def min_fights_to_unify_colors(a, b, c):
    # If all colors are already the same, no fights are needed
    if a == b == c:
        return 0
    
    # If the difference between any two colors is more than 1, it's impossible to unify
    if abs(a - b) > 1 or abs(b - c) > 1 or abs(a - c) > 1:
        return -1
    
    # Calculate the number of fights needed
    total_fights = a + b + c - 3
    if total_fights <= 3:
        return total_fights
    else:
        return -1
